items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds 'My pleasure.'

ctx.x: Jerry was interviewed via Zoom on November 2, 2023 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very appreciative of Jerry Hey joining me for a chat. Thank you.
